acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:0b61d6ac-.title: Senior Growth Marketing Campaigns Manager
acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:0b61d6ac-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. You're not here to run plays someone else drew up. You're the one who figures out what the plays should be—then makes sure they hit. The Senior Growth Marketing Campaigns Manager sets the strategic direction for Vanta's integrated campaign programs for one of our core segments, connecting the right story, the right audience, and the right growth bets to build pipeline for the best Agentic Trust Platform on the market with one of the best teams in the business. You'll own demand generation end-to-end: from the annual campaign strategy for your segment to the post-event debrief to the budget that makes it all move. If you're the kind of marketer who gets a little too excited about a well-timed nurture sequence, a wacky stunt in the middle of SF, or a channel mix that punches embarrassingly above its budget—and you have opinions about why it worked—you'll fit right in. What you’ll do as Senior Growth Marketing Campaigns Manager at Vanta: - Architect and execute integrated campaign strategy (brand, launch, event, demand) across key channels - Own the numbers and define what good looks like: MQL, pipeline contribution, conversion rates. Set the standard, report against it, and optimize - Build the campaign infrastructure for your segment. From frameworks, playbooks, to templates that scales output with AI tools - Partner with Product Marketing as a strategic peer to design launch campaigns, inform demand campaigns, and plan sales plays - Lock arms with Sales and SDR on lead routing, follow-up SLAs, and honest feedback loops (yes, even the uncomfortable ones) - Serve as the campaign roadmap owner for your segment, run the campaign calendar and budget with the discipline of someone who's had to defend every line item in a board review - Lead the ABM strategy for priority verticals in your segment design the playbook, then make sure it actually runs - Implement AI solutions that make life easier: yours, your stakeholders', and your buyers'—with curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying it responsibly - Mentor junior marketers and raise the overall craft of the campaigns function How to be successful in this role: - 8+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation or growth marketing—you've built programs, not just shipped campaigns - A proven track record owning integrated campaigns end-to-end: from strategy and brief to results and budget accountability - Analytical fluency: you set the measurement standard, not just read the dashboard—and you know the difference between a signal and noise - Cross-functional range: you've worked shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales, SDR, creative, and Product Marketing, lived to tell the tale, and somehow made them all want to work with you again - Hands-on with marketing automation (HubSpot) and Salesforce—you've probably already spotted three things you'd change after logging in for the first time - Executive-level communicator: you can write a sharp brief, present a performance read-out to a VP, and influence a campaign strategy conversation without anyone feeling managed - A builder's instinct: you leave teams, processes, and programs better than you found them - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship. - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medic

anacorp-ana-corp:lever:9cd05287-6c6b-42f.title: Technical Training Technician
anacorp-ana-corp:lever:9cd05287-6c6b-42f.description: About ANA: Join a recognized industry leader - Alliance North America was proudly named a 2025 Top Workplace in the Manufacturing Industry, an honor based entirely on feedback from our own employees about our culture, values, and workplace experience. Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, and ANA’s patented EBOSS® Hybrid Energy System and Smart load bank system. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment. ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada, with locations in Cypress, California, and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is growing and scaling, and we are seeking a Technical Training Technician in an onsite position in Spartanburg, South Carolina. As a Technical Training Technician, you will deliver hands-on manufacturing training, support operator qualification, maintain accurate training records, and reinforce standardized work across the production floor. You will help ensure employees are trained consistently and prepared to perform assigned work safely, correctly, and efficiently. The position is fully onsite, and the work schedule is weekdays from 8:00 AM-5:00 PM. This role reports to the Plant Manager.
responsibilities: Deliver hands-on onboarding, station training, cross-training, refresher training, and requalification for production employees using approved work instructions, SOPs, visual aids, and training plans.
Demonstrate assembly, disassembly, inspection, material-handling, equipment-use, safety, and quality requirements at the workstation level.
Coordinate structured shadowing and supervised practice, coach employees during the learning process, and provide clear feedback on progress and remaining skill gaps.
Administer practical skill observations and qualification checklists, document demonstrated competency, and recommend employees for certification when established requirements are met.
Maintain complete and audit-ready training records, including attendance, qualification checklists, training acknowledgments, requalification status, and the operator skills matrix.
Ensure current work instructions, SOPs, visual aids, and other approved training materials are available at the point of use, and remove obsolete or superseded materials from the production floor.
Identify unclear instructions, missing visuals, difficult-to-teach steps, and recurring employee questions; provide documented feedback to the Technical Training Engineer for review and correction.
Observe employees performing trained work, reinforce standardized work, and escalate repeated deviations, unsafe practices, quality concerns, or process issues to the appropriate leader.
Support new product introduction and pilot builds by learning new processes, assisting with trial training, capturing operator feedback, and supporting the rollout of approved training to production.
Partner with production supervisors, Quality, Safety, Engineering, and the Technical Training Engineer to identify capability gaps and prioritize training needs.
Track training activity and provide routine status updates on onboarding progress, qualification coverage, overdue training, requalification needs, and cross-training readiness.
Maintain training tools, sample components, demonstration materials, mockups, and designated training areas in a safe, organized, and ready-to-use condition.
Assist with practical skills assessments for production candidates and support 30-, 60-, and 90-day employee competency reviews as requested.
Train and coach production employees on manufacturing principles and practices, including Lean, 5S, Kanban, standard work, and continuous improvement.
Other duties as assigned
qualifications: High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree, technical certificate, apprenticeship, or military technical training preferred.
Two or more years of experience in manufacturing, production assembly, equipment maintenance, technical service, or hands-on workforce training; equivalent military experience will be considered.
Demonstrated ability to safely perform and teach hands-on technical tasks using hand tools, power tools, production equipment, PPE, and established safety procedures.
Ability to read and follow engineering drawings, bills of material, routings, work instructions, SOPs, and inspection criteria at the workstation level.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with genuine comfort demonstrating tasks, coaching employees, and providing constructive feedback on the production floor.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to maintain accurate training records, checklists, schedules, and skills-matrix information.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn work-instruction, learning-management, quality, and production systems.
Preferred: experience with TWI Job Instruction, lean manufacturing, standardized work, 5S, ISO 9001, or structured operator-certification programs.
Preferred: experience with electromechanical assembly, generators, compressors, power systems, industrial equipment, or related products.
Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, work in an active manufacturing environment, and lift or move up to 50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.

campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:5b8a95d4-54ef-.description: Please Note: This role is in-office in San Francisco at our headquarters, working with the entire company five days per week. We are not open to remote candidates. ABOUT US Campfire is on a mission to redefine the accounting software landscape by taking on giants like Netsuite to build modern accounting software for startups and mid-size tech companies. We graduated from Y Combinator's Summer 2023 cohort, and we are backed by prominent investors like Foundation Capital and a rapidly growing customer base. 🌟 THE ROLE Join our team as an AI Engineer at Campfire, where you'll design and implement AI-driven solutions that supercharge our accounting platform. From automating financial workflows to building intelligent features that provide real-time insights, you’ll be at the forefront of making accounting smarter, faster, and more intuitive for our customers. 💼 WE NEED SOMEONE WHO Has Expertise: - Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing (NLP). - Proven experience with frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow, and proficiency in Python. - Hands-on experience deploying ML models into production environments. - Familiarity with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Hugging Face) and fine-tuning for real-world use cases. Thrives in Agility: - Our team is lean and moves quickly. You’re comfortable experimenting, iterating, and shipping fast. Values Autonomy: - You take ownership end-to-end — from prototyping models to deploying and monitoring them in production. 👥 IDEAL CANDIDATE - You’re not just looking for a job; you’re seeking a challenge. - You’re passionate about applying AI to solve real business problems. - You want to build practical, customer-facing applications of AI rather than just research. - You’re eager to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and design in a fast-paced startup environment. 📢 LET’S CONNECT Think you’re the perfect fit? We’re excited to meet you! Reach out, share your story, and let’s explore how you can bring intelligence to Campfire’s mission. ❤️‍🩹 BENEFITS We provide top decile benefits, including: - 100% premium coverage for employees and 80% coverage for dependents - Comprehensive healthcare and dental care options

We help companies build high-performing teams across executive assistance, administrative support, customer support, sales support, recruiting, operations, and other critical business functions. The Role We're looking for a Head of Sales Performance to build, own, and multiply the performance of our inbound sales engine from the first follow-up touch through close. This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's. You won't be inheriting a finished machine; you'll be constructing one. That means creating the tools, sequences, collateral, coaching systems, and standards that make every rep on the floor measurably better and personally stepping into the work when needed. You will lead the inbound follow-up function, strengthen the systems and processes behind it, coach the team, and ensure every qualified opportunity is managed with discipline and urgency. Beyond your direct team, you will raise the quality and consistency of how the entire sales floor sells through coaching, performance management, process improvement, and the thoughtful use of sales technology. You will have a team, a modern sales tech stack, and clear revenue and performance targets tied directly to your ownership. As you establish the sales performance engine, your scope may expand into post-sale revenue onboarding, retention, and account expansion. jobgether-jobgether:lever:2c18af21-23ed-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Maltese Voice Actor – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Maltese voice professional to help shape the next generation of AI-powered voice technology. You will contribute your vocal expertise to training and evaluating advanced language and speech models. The role combines professional voice performance with linguistic evaluation, annotation, and AI-focused quality assessment. You will help improve how AI understands and reproduces Maltese pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotion, and regional variation. Working remotely, you will collaborate with a team using cutting-edge AI tools and evolving evaluation methods. Your contributions can help create more natural, accurate, and expressive voice experiences across a wide range of applications. This is a senior freelance opportunity for someone who wants to apply their Maltese voice expertise to the future of human-AI communication. Record high-quality scripted speech samples in Maltese for use in AI training and voice model development. Deliver clear, natural, expressive performances while maintaining accurate pronunciation, pacing, tone, and emotional nuance. Review and evaluate AI-generated speech outputs for linguistic accuracy, naturalness, pronunciation, and overall voice quality. Identify, annotate, and categorize errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated Maltese speech. Provide detailed expert feedback on pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, regional variation, and other relevant linguistic characteristics. Work with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation criteria, annotation approaches, and voice design guidelines. Apply professional voice and linguistic judgment consistently across a variety of recording and evaluation tasks. Help identify opportunities to improve the quality, authenticity, and cultural relevance of Maltese AI voice models. Maintain high standards of recording quality and follow technical and project-specific guidelines throughout the engagement. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in voice acting, dubbing, narration, broadcasting, or a closely related performance field in Maltese. Native-level or highly proficient Maltese language skills, with strong command of pronunciation, intonation, vocabulary, and natural spoken expression. Strong vocal control and the ability to communicate different tones, emotions, pacing, and styles authentically. Excellent listening and analytical skills, with the ability to identify subtle pronunciation, linguistic, and speech-quality issues. Exceptional attention to detail and consistency when reviewing recordings and AI-generated outputs. Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when providing structured feedback and annotations. Experience with linguistic annotation, language training, voice coaching, speech evaluation, or AI training projects is a plus. Comfortable learning and working with new AI tools, recording platforms, evaluation systems, and project workflows. Reliable, self-directed, and able to manage freelance work effectively in a remote environment. Access to a high-quality recording setup, including a reliable professional-grade microphone and a quiet, controlled recording environment. Secure computer equipment and a stable internet connection suitable for remote recording and AI-related project work. Benefits Freelance contract opportunity with a remote workplace setup . Competitive pay ranging from $6 to $65 USD per hour , depending on experience, expertise, and geographic location. Flexible freelance engagement that allows you to contribute to AI development remotely. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and speech technologies. jobgether-jobgether:lever:4b61ed96-ae22-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a GTM Product Manager - Marketing Operations based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to shape the strategy and execution of marketing operations within a fast-growing, globally distributed organization. You will take ownership of complex operational challenges and translate business needs into scalable product solutions. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help improve processes, systems, automation, and data-driven decision-making. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and a strong focus on measurable business outcomes. You will collaborate with senior leaders and experienced teams while helping drive innovation across the go-to-market organization. Success in this position requires curiosity, ownership, strong product judgment, and a practical approach to leveraging automation and AI.
